business_summary.text: WeWork India operates a branded flexible workspace network across eight Indian cities, offering core workspace, value-added services and digital products.

call_points.text: FY27 capex guidance held at ₹500-600 Cr; management sees visibility today.
Customization revenue guided at ₹10-15 Cr a quarter as large managed-office customization is amortised.
VAS revenue seen at 11-12% of total and digital at 3-4%, together about 16%.
FY27 top-line growth guided at over 20% YoY; no explicit revenue number given.
28,000 seats to be added in FY27, of which 11,000 are signed managed-office deals opening at 100% occupancy.
14,000 desks to become operational by end of Q1 FY27; 40% of that is managed office.
Locked-in core revenue of ₹2,940 Cr, up 34% YoY, against locked-in rental cost of ₹986 Cr.
FY27 opens with ₹1,885 Cr of core revenue already locked in, growing at 36% CAGR over two years.
GCCs contribute about 40% of existing members and close to 50% of new sales last year.
FY26 EBITDA margin of 20.2% includes ₹9 Cr one-time IPO cost; normalized margin is 20.5%.
Credit rating upgraded two notches from A- to A+.
New Rivet design-and-build business targets a $35–40 billion market, capital-light with no lease liability.
VAS revenue expected to stay around 12–13% of revenue; Q4's 14% included large customization revenue.
Lease renewals over the next one to two years may see rental jumps above normal escalations in tight micro-markets.
